name: Saudi Electricity Company PP13 and PP14 combined-cycle power plants, Riyadh - CENTUM VP DCS and OTS orders
description: Automation.com, 3 March 2015 (source Yokogawa Corporation of America), read via r.jina.ai: each plant has 'a combined net electric output of 1,980 MW'; PP13 blocks 1 and 2 scheduled May and October 2016, PP14 November 2016 and April 2017; CENTUM VP covers gas turbines, heat recovery boilers, steam turbines and electric systems (IEC 61850) plus a plant operator training simulator. Yokogawa Saudi Arabia also received a 2012 order for the 2,175 MW PP12 plant. No order value printed.
